issues.on_page: Depreciation Fund Non-Revenue Receipts 110,108.17; Schedule C p19 '5200 Allocation from General Fund'
issues.issue: This is an interfund allocation, which is in effect a transfer, but it is recorded as revenue: here in receipts and in detail[167] (Schedule C), both as 'other'. The General Fund's schedules (B p17-18, M p23-29) show no matching outflow. Only its 25,000 transfer to School Nutrition is shown. decision_needed already asks about this, so it is a warning here. If it is a transfer, governmental receipts are overstated by 110,108.17.

issues.on_page: 2310 Board of Education - Other Property Services 134,227.99
issues.issue: This is a large Board of Education 'Other Property Services' line. In Nebraska school accounting it usually holds insurance and other purchased services, so 'insurance' may fit better. It is a judgment call.
